scope: Render corrected past/current-only manual review packets from the frozen R3 formal episodes; no recollection, relabeling, event reselection, probe, or policy training
reason: The original R3 packet renderer used center-2..center+2 and therefore exposed two future frames despite the frozen review rule. Those packets are invalid for formal human review.

window_policy.episode_start_padding: repeat frame 0 on the left until five frames are present
window_policy.target_frame: the fifth/rightmost frame in every contact sheet and the final frame of every MP4

invalid_original_packets: The original center-2..center+2 packet files and montages must not be used for formal human review.
